structuredContent.body:
New organization Admins now land on Quick start, which is the first Admin menu item. The guide covers agent internet controls, audit-log setup, and invitations. Admins can copy the complete Markdown guide; a manual fallback works without clipboard access or JavaScript. IdP enrollment remains Planned.

The page checks current Admin access and uses the selected organization's trusted name plus configured portal and MCP URLs. Later sign-ins and normal workspace selection keep their existing destinations.

Review: preliminary T2 due to the new browser route/creation redirect and required app-to-web configuration member. Independent architect approval of the finished candidate is required. The PR remains Draft while the final ordinary suite, environment gates, metrics, and complete review are in progress.

Candidate: [e65d3502](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/e65d35020472dd6ee7fe2f4ec7b5b553441ef48a). [Validation](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474821759) · [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474822296).
